criteria.name: shipped_segments_match

criteria.name: rotated_summary_matches

criteria.name: relocated_copy_matches
criteria.description: On a copy of book M under a folder path with spaces, all nine documents equal the expected documents exactly.

criteria.name: missing_input_is_named
criteria.description: With permits.csv, exclusions.json or both deleted, the program writes no documents, exits 1 and reports ERROR MISSING_FILE with the first missing file in declared order.

criteria.name: reruns_identical
criteria.description: Two runs on copies of the same book from different folders write identical strictly typed JSON document values.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: Penalty: on hidden book H1 the program substitutes the shipped book's selected lists or total benefit for that book's own answers.
